open_points.subject: create-project replay after the created project changes
open_points.text: a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: What observable result or failure is required when the original create is retried after its project has been corrected or otherwise changed without being erased or anonymised?
options: Return the existing project with its current values and create nothing
Refuse the retry because the project no longer has the created values
Treat the retry as a new create and mint a second project
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the retry and create nothing, because returning changed content would not replay the original result and creating a duplicate would be surprising.

witness.initial: The owner created active project P with request id Q, display name A and object address X; P is revision 1.
events: The owner corrects P's display name to B, producing revision 2.
After losing or repeating the earlier interaction, the owner retries the original create request with request id Q, name A and address X.
outcomes: Registry recognises Q and returns or refuses against existing project P; no second project is created.
Because P no longer keeps its original values, Registry treats the retry as a new create and mints project P2 with name A and address X.
witness.observer: The owner sees either one project or two projects in the catalogue.
